title: Детская кроватка и коньяк  (The Baby Crib and the Cognac)

segments.t: At the bar counter, Kostya accidentally smashes a bottle of cognac and hurries to mop it up before anyone sees. Just then, a deliveryman brings a baby crib to the hotel because Max absentmindedly gave the restaurant address instead of Vika's apartment.
Загружу машину, а потом помогу поднять.
Не надо. Костя, чем это пахнет?
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Kostyan, did you break the cognac?' Notice how Russian expresses 'Kostyan' and 'broke' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'I am simply tidying up here.' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'clean up' in spoken Russian.
'And what is this?' Vika raises the pitch on 'such' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Max answers right away.
'A baby crib.' Max anchors the line on 'children's', while 'baby crib' completes the thought.
'Sign right here, please.' In Russian, the idea of 'sign' flows naturally into 'please' without extra filler words.
'Forgive me, I mixed everything up.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'forgive' and finishing on 'everything'.
'Instead of the home address I wrote the work one.' Max anchors the line on 'instead of', while 'working' completes the thought.
'Next time you will be more careful.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'next' and finishing on 'more carefully'.
'Maybe I can pay you extra?' Vika chooses the respectful plural 'you' alongside 'will pay extra' to keep a polite distance. Max answers right away.
'Vika, let me drive it over.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Vika' before landing on 'will drop off'.
Загружу машину, а потом помогу поднять.
'I will load the car and then help carry it up.' Max brings out the contrast between 'will load' and 'car' in a few short words.
Не надо. Костя, чем это пахнет?
'No need. Kostya, what is that smell?' The meaning hinges on 'not' working together with 'to smell' in spoken Russian. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Загружу машину, а потом помогу поднять.
Не надо. Костя, чем это пахнет?
That finishes the scene at the bar counter. Notice how Max apologizes for mixing up the home and work addresses, right before Vika catches the scent of spilled cognac. See you next time!
